name: vestaboard-note-smart-display
description: Self-updating Vestaboard Note display: calendar events, morning weather, and an idle clock

scripts.build:native: swiftc -o native/get-events native/get-events.swift -framework EventKit && codesign --force --sign - --entitlements native/entitlements.plist native/get-events && swiftc -o native/summarize native/summarize.swift -framework FoundationModels
